notes: Cog-WM LHMM combines a learned BCP execution-length policy with an observation-based recurrent progress monitor (RPM/AEP) on a frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1 one-epoch SFT backbone. The two modules jointly determine when to continue execution or replan. Full RoboCasa365 target50 evaluation achieved 64.52% success (1613/2500), improving over the BCP-only and RPM/AEP-only configurations by 1.56 and 0.88 percentage points, respectively. The PR describes the method, training, evaluation protocol and reproduction materials.
